# Spoken audio

<!-- Generated by `npm run profiles`; edit scripts/profiles.ts or the guidance files, not this. -->

Measured on 500 of LC's spoken audio recordings. A field is **shown** when 50% or more of them have it, and **suggested** at 10% to 50%, unless an override says otherwise. An existing record also gets a row for every value it has, whatever its tier. [All kinds](README.md) · [The rules](../which-fields.md)

## Defined by

A record is a spoken audio when its Work's type is `NonMusicAudio` or `Audio`, and no kind above it in [the list](README.md) matches first. Choosing spoken audio for a new record writes: Work type `NonMusicAudio`.

## Overrides

None: every tier here comes from the measured share.

## Available through Add field

Properties some of LC's spoken audio recordings have that the sections don't offer: under 10% of them, or moved here by an override. Add field offers these and every other BIBFRAME property, with their shares.

`bf:hasItem` 10%, `bf:editionStatement` 9%, `bf:supplementaryContent` 9%, `bf:usageAndAccessPolicy` 6%, `bf:systemRequirement` 3%, `bf:accompaniedBy` 1%, `bf:temporalCoverage` 1%

## Never offered

Record-keeping and structure, whatever their share: `bf:adminMetadata`, `bf:instanceOf`, `bf:hasInstance`, `bflc:aap`, `bflc:aap-normalized`, `dcterms:isPartOf`.
